description: Body of a webhook delivery, signed with Standard Webhooks headers (webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature). Verify the raw body before parsing it, and ignore fields and event types this schema does not name.

billingAccountId.description: Your identifier for the billing account the event is about, when it is about one.

environment.description: The environment of the project instance the event belongs to.

id.description: The event. It is also the webhook-id header and stays the same across retries and replays: deduplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the fact the event reports happened.

type.description: What happened. Ignore types you do not handle.

title: Quotum outbound domain event
